label: Impact of COVID-19 Infection and Vaccination on Abdominal-based Microvascular Breast Reconstruction Outcomes.
summary: SARS-CoV-2 (COVID-19) infection increases thrombotic risk; however, its impact on microsurgical breast reconstruction outcomes remains unclear. This study examines postoperative complications in patients following abdominal-based microvascular breast reconstruction relative to (1) timing relative to the COVID-19 pandemic, (2) history of COVID-19 infection, and (3) time since COVID-19 vaccination/booster.
